say:2:1041569901:1.text: Your Majesty, it's my highest honor to be in your presence.
say:2:1041569901:1.source_cn: 向您致敬，尊敬的陛下，能见到您真是我的无上荣幸。

say:3:1041569902:1.text: And you, that smug little grin is an insult to your own title.
say:3:1041569902:1.source_cn: 你这让人恶心的笑脸也真是辜负你自己的头衔。

say:4:1041569903:1.text: Well, that title's long gone, just like my mother's crown.
say:4:1041569903:1.source_cn: 毕竟那玩意已经不复存在了——跟我母亲的王权一样。

say:5:1041569904:1.text: So whenever I see a king, I feel compelled to say hello. And naturally, you're first on my list.
say:5:1041569904:1.source_cn: 所以每当看到一位国王陛下，我就会忍不住过来打个招呼——...

say:6:1041569905:1.text: Ah, "first"... such a lovely, distant word. You must agree, yes? Care to drink to it?
say:6:1041569905:1.source_cn: 哎呀呀，第一次，多么美妙又遥远的词，您想必也有同感吧？...

say:7:1041569906:1.text: I pity your mother. You'd have made a better jester than a prince.
say:7:1041569906:1.source_cn: 我同情你母亲，比起王储，你更适合当个小丑。

say:8:1041569907:1.text: Oh, I agree. But sadly, my great mother valued my competence more than my sense of humor.
say:8:1041569907:1.source_cn: 我也这么觉得，可惜我那伟大的母亲比起我的幽默感，显然更...

say:9:1041569908:1.text: Competence? You mean the preening and the cheap theatrics?
say:9:1041569908:1.source_cn: 能力？你这花里胡哨的模样和轻浮的举止吗？

say:10:1041569909:1.text: Don't judge by appearances, Your Majesty. Being old doesn't always mean living long—
say:10:1041569909:1.source_cn: 别那么在意外表，陛下，我必须得说，长得老并不代表活得久——

say:11:1041569910:1.text: Of course, that doesn't necessarily apply to you. You've had two lives already...
say:11:1041569910:1.source_cn: 啊，当然了，这话是针对那些凡夫俗子，可不适用于您，毕竟...

say:12:1041569911:1.text: Speaking of which, when the dead return to the world, can we really call it "living"?
say:12:1041569911:1.source_cn: 对了，话说以亡灵之身重返世间，这能叫“活”吗？

say:13:1041569912:1.text:
...
What exactly are you getting at?

say:14:1041569913:1.text: Nothing. Only that I'd dread seeing my mother become like you. That would be a nightmare beyond nightmares.
say:14:1041569913:1.source_cn: 别在意，只是我有点害怕我母亲像您一样，那可真是世界上最...

say:15:1041569914:1.text: Truth is, I'm a lot older than this pretty face suggests. By the numbers, we could almost be brothers.
say:15:1041569914:1.source_cn: 更何况，我的年龄可比我这美丽的外表看起来大不少，按年份...

say:16:1041569915:1.text: Brothers? You got a death wish.
say:16:1041569915:1.source_cn: 哈，想当我的兄弟？看起来你是真活够了。

say:17:1041569916:1.text: Maybe I do. Already picked my executioner. Poor fool doesn't even know it.
say:17:1041569916:1.source_cn: 谁说不是呢？说真的，我甚至给自己准备好了刽子手，但可惜...

say:18:1041569917:1.text: Too loyal to play his part—that's almost a betrayal in itself, wouldn't you say?
say:18:1041569917:1.source_cn: 因为过于忠诚，反而未能按照我的预期行事，这又何尝不是一...

say:19:1041569918:1.text: And from what I hear, your brother repaid your trust by turning on you. Looks like we've walked the same road.
say:19:1041569918:1.source_cn: 说到这个，听说您的兄弟是在您无比的信任中背叛了您，您瞧...

say:21:1041569920:1.text: Oh, don't be so touchy. We're both royals, and we've each had the pleasure of watching our kingdom fall... though only once so far.
say:21:1041569920:1.source_cn: 别生气嘛。您看，咱们都是王室成员，还都有着丰富的亡国经...

say:22:1041569921:1.text: Now we find ourselves face to face, with more in common than either of us might like. It almost feels like destiny.
say:22:1041569921:1.source_cn: 咱们能相聚于此，还有这么多共同语言，这是多难得的缘分？

say:23:1041569922:1.text: And who knows? Keep trying, and maybe you'll outdo me.
say:23:1041569922:1.source_cn: 更别说您这么努力，说不定还能比我多体验一回呢。

say:24:1041569923:1.text: Tell you what, I'll concede. You've lost two kingdoms, I've only lost one. Congratulations on your win, Your Majesty!
say:24:1041569923:1.source_cn: 要不这样，我提前认输，2:1，恭喜您在亡国次数上赢我一...

say:26:1041569925:1.text:
Huff...
Get out of my sight before I smash you and everything around you into pieces!
say:26:1041569925:1.source_cn: 呼……\n在我把你和眼前这所有东西都劈成碎块之前，滚出...
